description:
Create a Post -- MakeHybrid API plan, POST /linkedin/v2/{account_id}/posts, group posts.

THE WORDS ARE YOURS TO WRITE. This API carries them to the page and keeps them; it holds none of the member's pricing, product, launch dates or announcements, so missing a fact, draft anyway and ask for that one line alongside the draft. HOW A POST FOR THIS MEMBER MUST READ: First line under eight words and no emoji in it. No emoji anywhere unless the member has asked for them -- no rocket, no tick marks, none as bullets. No markdown: LinkedIn renders none of it, so **bold** arrives on the page as asterisks. NEVER a long dash (the em dash). Write two sentences, or use a comma. Contractions, sentences of uneven length, and one concrete thing -- a number, a name, a week. No Ready to...? close, no Thoughts?, no call to action unless the member asked for one. Stop on the last real sentence. Show it to the member before anything is published.

account_id.description: Value for the {account_id} segment of /linkedin/v2/{account_id}/posts. Required; pass it raw (it is URL-escaped for you).

query.description: Optional query-string parameters, e.g. {"limit":"20","cursor":"..."}. Values are coerced to strings.
